documents.title: AR Aging Report Technical Design
documents.content: AR Aging Report is sourced from rcm.vw_ar_detail and rcm.vw_ar_aging_summary through the pb_ar_aging import dataset. Balances are snapshotted nightly by rcm.sp_load_ar_fact. Any structural change requires a financial reconciliation of charges, payments, adjustments, denials and balances before deployment.

documents.title: RCM Warehouse Standards
documents.content: Dimension attributes surfaced on fact tables must be denormalised in the loading stored procedure rather than joined at the reporting layer. Every fact table column addition requires a migration script, a rollback script and unit tests for null, duplicate and datatype validation.

documents.title: Power BI Deployment Runbook
documents.content: Dataset schema changes require a semantic model refresh in the RCM Analytics workspace, validation of impacted measures, and a published validation report comparing pre-change and post-change totals.
